uncertainty_note: Two distinct quantities are reported and never combined. 'bootstrap_ci_over_images' is a stratified bootstrap within a SINGLE seed and describes sampling variability over images from the same evaluated image distribution. The resampling unit is an image, not a patient: patient identity is unverified for this dataset. 'across_seeds' is the mean +/- s.d. of the three per-seed point estimates and describes training variability. The three seeds score identical images, so pooling them into one image-level interval would treat correlated predictions as independent.
